howToPlay.zh: 点哪里都能敲木鱼，功德 +1。连敲三下开始念经，节奏稳定（每秒约 1.5–4 下）就会入禅：画面变暖、光晕变亮、余音变长，功德随之加倍，停手两秒后慢慢回落。念经时偶尔会结缘法物，摆在木鱼前：录音机会念「南无阿弥陀佛」，线香冒烟，小沙弥跟着点头……每件只来一次。法物可以拖动；点右下角「法物」打开面板，逐件启用或停用。每天第一次入定，木鱼嘴里会飞出一支签，看完收起还有 30 秒好运；求到的签收进面板里的签谱（共 60 支）。偶尔还会有好运：福报让功德变金、×3，好运让花瓣飘落、结缘机会 ×3。键盘：选中游戏画面后按空格或回车敲击，E 打开法物面板（S 切换法物、皮肤、签谱），C 查看已结缘的法物。
howToPlay.en: Tap anywhere to strike the wooden fish: merit +1. After three knocks it starts chanting; a steady beat (about 1.5–4 strikes a second) deepens zen: the scene warms, the glow brightens, the knock rings longer and merit multiplies, fading two seconds after you stop. While chanting, strikes sometimes bring a relic that sits in front of the fish: the chanting box chants Namo Amitabha (南无阿弥陀佛), incense smokes, the little monk nods along… Each comes once. Drag relics anywhere; the Relics button at the bottom right opens a panel to switch each one on or off. The first samadhi of each day sends a fortune lot flying out of the fish's mouth; put it away for 30 s of good luck, and find all sixty in the panel's lot book. Luck comes too: a blessing turns merit gold (×3), good luck brings falling petals (drops ×3). Keyboard: focus the game, then Space or Enter strikes, E opens the relic panel (S switches relics, skins and lots) and C reads the collected relics.
